name: CI

# Fast checks that need no image build: the Go tools' unit tests, the Hadron
# pin consistency check, the palette drift check, and syntax checks on the
# session scripts and configs.
# The image itself is built by release.yml and, for the agent, agent-gates.yml.

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # The agent appliance's Go code and its harness checks that need no image.
  # The image build and the VM gates are in agent-gates.yml.
  agent:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version-file: agent/go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: agent/go.sum

      - name: agent formatting
        working-directory: agent
        run: |
          unformatted="$(gofmt -l .)"
          if [[ -n "$unformatted" ]]; then
            echo "These files are not gofmt-clean:" >&2
            echo "$unformatted" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: agent vet, build, and tests with the race detector
        working-directory: agent
        run: |
          go vet ./...
          go build ./...
          go test -race ./...

      - name: Agent harness shell sources parse
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mapfile -t scripts < <(
            find test/agent test/boot-ux tools -type f -name '*.sh' -print | sort
          )
          if (( ${#scripts[@]} == 0 )); then
            echo "Expected to find agent harness shell scripts" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          for script in "${scripts[@]}"; do
            echo "bash -n $script"
            bash -n "$script"
          done

      # The first-boot Chromium shell unit tests are hermetic: they drive the
      # install/persistence/launch logic through a fake flatpak and temp dirs,
      # no docker or VM. The other test/agent/*_test.sh are only parsed above:
      # some need a built image. browser_units_test.sh is an image check and
      # runs in agent-gates.yml after the build.
      - name: Agent browser unit tests (hermetic)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for t in test/agent/browser_install_test.sh \
                   test/agent/browser_persistence_test.sh \
                   test/agent/browser_run_test.sh; do
            echo "== $t"
            bash "$t"
          done

  unit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version-file: update/go.mod
          cache: false

      # The backup test that runs the real restic needs it on PATH: the
      # version the Dockerfile pins, so the test and the image agree.
      - name: restic for the backup test
        run: |
          v=$(sed -n 's/^ARG RESTIC_VERSION=//p' Dockerfile)
          go install "github.com/restic/restic/cmd/restic@v$v"
          echo "$(go env GOPATH)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: isotope tests
        working-directory: update
        run: go vet ./... && go test ./...

      - name: install-ui tests
        working-directory: install-ui
        run: |
          test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
          go vet ./... && go test -race ./...

      # The graphical installer needs cgo and, for its screenshot tests,
      # Mesa's software renderer (llvmpipe) behind EGL's surfaceless
      # platform. The PNGs in install-gui/testdata are compared within a
      # small tolerance.
      - name: install-gui build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends \
            libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev libegl-dev libgles-dev libegl-mesa0 libgl1-mesa-dri

      # The shared look of the graphical tools (guikit/): pure Go, no GPU.
      - name: guikit tests
        working-directory: guikit
        run: |
          test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
          go vet ./... && go test ./...

      - name: install-gui tests
        working-directory: install-gui
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: "1"
          EGL_PLATFORM: surfaceless
          # Fail, not skip, when Mesa cannot give a context.
          ISOTOPE_GUI_REQUIRE_SCREENSHOTS: "1"
        run: |
          test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
          go vet -tags nox11,novulkan ./... && go test -tags nox11,novulkan ./...

      - name: welcome tests
        working-directory: welcome
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: "1"
          EGL_PLATFORM: surfaceless
        run: |
          test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
          go vet -tags nox11,novulkan ./... && go test -tags nox11,novulkan ./...

      # Isotope System: its models and pages against a fake daemon and a
      # fake NetworkManager. No golden screenshots yet.
      - name: system tests
        working-directory: system
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: "1"
        run: |
          test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"
          go vet -tags nox11,novulkan ./... && go test -race -tags nox11,novulkan ./...

      # A rename that moves a file but not the links to it leaves the link
      # dangling, and systemd then refuses the unit with no build error.
      # Absolute targets resolve in the image, not here, so skip them.
      - name: No dangling relative symlinks
        run: |
          bad=$(find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type l -print | while read -r l; do
            case "$(readlink "$l")" in /*) continue ;; esac
            [ -e "$l" ] || echo "$l -> $(readlink "$l")"
          done)
          if [ -n "$bad" ]; then echo "dangling symlinks:"; echo "$bad"; exit 1; fi

      - name: Hadron pins agree
        run: scripts/bump-hadron.sh --check

      - name: Version pins are tracked by Renovate
        run: scripts/check-renovate-pins.sh

      - name: Saved networks and device settings survive a reboot
        run: test/state/test-persist-state.sh

      - name: Configs match the Isotope palette
        run: python3 tools/gen-theme.py --check

      # The splash's password agent: ask-file parsing, the panel title, the
      # retry rule, and the reply on a real socket.
      - name: Boot splash password agent
        run: make -C splash test

      # The image build draws the wallpapers; a non-deterministic generator
      # would make every build ship different bytes. The committed GRUB
      # pictures must still be what the palette and the splash draw.
      - name: Wallpapers are deterministic, GRUB pictures match the palette
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for d in a b; do
            python3 tools/gen-wallpaper.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/$d" isotope-tiles-night-480x270 isotope-plain-day-480x270
          done
          cmp "$RUNNER_TEMP/a/isotope-tiles-night-480x270.png" "$RUNNER_TEMP/b/isotope-tiles-night-480x270.png"
          cmp "$RUNNER_TEMP/a/isotope-plain-day-480x270.png" "$RUNNER_TEMP/b/isotope-plain-day-480x270.png"
          # The login screen's soft wallpapers (--blur), made the same way.
          python3 tools/test_gen_wallpaper.py
          make -C splash isotope-splash
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/grub"
          python3 tools/gen-grub-bg.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/grub"
          # The background is the splash's float arithmetic; another compiler
          # or libm may round a pixel differently, so allow one step.
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/grub" rootfs/etc/kairos/branding/isotope-theme <<'PY'
          import sys, pathlib
          new, old = map(pathlib.Path, sys.argv[1:])
          for f in sorted(new.glob("*.tga")):
              a, b = f.read_bytes(), (old / f.name).read_bytes()
              assert len(a) == len(b) and a[:18] == b[:18], f"{f.name}: size or header differs"
              worst = max(abs(x - y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
              assert worst <= 1, f"{f.name} differs from the committed one (by {worst}): run tools/gen-grub-bg.py"
          PY

      - name: Prebuilt stage keys
        run: |
          python3 tools/test_stage_key.py
          for gpu in full vm; do
            make -s GPU="$gpu" STAGE=cosmic-shell print-stage-key
            make -s GPU="$gpu" STAGE=cosmic-apps print-stage-key
          done

      - name: Shortcut sheets match the configs
        run: |
          python3 tools/test_gen_shortcuts.py
          python3 tools/gen-shortcuts.py --check

      - name: COSMIC theme overlay
        run: python3 tools/test_gen_theme.py

      - name: Notification keys
        run: test/notify/check-notify-keys.sh
      # The emoji picker with a fake picker, clipboard and notifier, the
      # list generator on a fixture, and the Super+; binding per variant.
      - name: Emoji picker
        run: test/emoji/check-emoji.sh

      # The i3 launcher passes the X cookie file to Flatpak, so sandboxed apps
      # can open a window.
      - name: Flatpak X11 authorization
        run: test/flatpak/check-x11-auth.sh

      # The firmware installers on a fake linux-firmware and sof-bin tree:
      # top-level links, --newest, --require, SOF links.
      - name: Firmware install scripts
        run: test/firmware/check-install-firmware.sh

      - name: Session scripts and configs parse
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for f in rootfs*/usr/bin/* scripts/*.sh test/boot-ux/*.sh test/notify/*.sh; do
            if head -n1 "$f" | grep -q bash; then bash -n "$f"; else sh -n "$f"; fi
          done
          jq empty rootfs-sway/etc/xdg/waybar/config
          jq empty rootfs-niri/usr/share/isotope/noctalia-palettes/Isotope.json
          # The COSMIC dock pins only apps the image ships. Isotope has no
          # browser (Flathub's Firefox is org.mozilla.firefox), so upstream's
          # "firefox" pin would show a broken icon.
          dock=rootfs-cosmic/usr/share/cosmic/com.system76.CosmicAppList/v1/favorites
          grep -q '"com.system76.CosmicFiles"' "$dock"
          ! grep -qi firefox "$dock"

      # The old name of the app picker opens Isotope Welcome's Apps page.
      - name: isotope-first-run-apps link
        run: test/first-run/check-first-run-apps.sh

      # Docker runs it in a throwaway Alpine container, with fake tools.
      - name: isotope-night-light state and toggle
        run: test/night-light/check-night-light.sh
      - name: Clipboard history dispatch and wiring
        run: test/clipboard/dispatch_test.sh
      - name: Extensions menu entry and wiring
        run: test/extensions/check-extensions-menu.sh
      - name: Isotope System from the menu, and its wiring
        run: test/system/check-system-menu.sh
      - name: Extension catalog from the registry tags
        run: test/extensions/check-extensions-catalog.sh
      - name: COSMIC build patches (repo, libcosmic, target dir hash)
        run: test/cosmic-build/test-cosmic-build-patches.sh
      - name: libcosmic rev check (offline fixtures)
        run: test/cosmic-build/test-check-libcosmic-rev.sh
      - name: libcosmic rev matches the epoch (network)
        run: test/cosmic-build/check-libcosmic-rev.sh
